newsitem.title: USA: Pudgie's loses ruling, files Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Pudgie's loses ruling, files Chapter 11.

text.p: Pudgie's Chicken Inc said Wednesday that it has been ordered to pay a developer $1.375 million in damages and $331,516 in attorneys fees by a panel of the American Aribration Association.
In response, the company said it will oppose the motion and to protect its interests and assets, has filed a Chapter 11 petition for reorganization.
A motion to confirm the award to the developer, Gallus Investments L.P., is scheduled for the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia on September 27, the company said.
Trading on Pudgie's was halted at 3-3/4 at 1500 EDT.
